note: Seed snapshot copied from ic-micro-bench/ic-microbench/results.json. samplesMs are the raw per-iteration timings for each round; per-round iterations differ because the runner auto-calibrates. samplesNsPerIteration is derived (ms * 1e6 / iterations) and pooled across rounds. loop_control is the induction/comparison profile; consumers subtract its per-profile median from every other case then divide by opsPerIteration to obtain loop-adjusted ns/op.
